testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore Team Web from Show Panels: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:667:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore Team Web from Show Panels ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Team Web panel is visible ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the Options panel title menu ✔ Then Team Web is checked ✔ When the user selects Team Web ✔ Then the Team Web panel disappears from the Tools ribbon ✔ And the other visible Tools panels remain available ✔ When the user reopens Show Panels from the Options panel title menu ✔ Then Team Web is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Team Web ✔ Then the Team Web panel appears on the Tools ribbon ✔ And Show Panels marks Team Web as visible
